description: Search setlist.fm for cities by name or country. Returns city name, state, country, and geolocation coordinates. Useful for resolving city identifiers before searching setlists or venues.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code — "DE", not "Germany". Call `countries` for the full list.

name.description: City name, e.g. "Berlin". At least one of name/country is required.

name: cities
